logs.limited: Showing the {{limit}} newest entries matching the filters — narrow the filters to see older ones.

notDownloaded.title: This chapter has not been downloaded

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Crawler parameters. The speed limits are deliberate, to avoid overloading the source websites.

validation.timeout: Enter a number of seconds greater than 0
validation.delay: At least 0.5 seconds — to avoid overloading the source websites

settings.envNote: Settings are written to the file {{file}} in the directory the server runs from and apply to jobs started after all running jobs have finished. Operating system environment variables, if set, still take precedence over this file.
settings.userAgentHint: Identify as a bot and leave a way to contact you, e.g. crawl-data-app/0.1 (+mailto:you@example.com)

delay.label: Delay between requests (seconds)
delay.description: At least 0.5. The crawler sends at most 1 request per delay.

concurrency.label: Max concurrent requests
concurrency.description: Between 1 and 8. Only matters when the website responds slower than the delay.

retries.label: Retries
retries.description: On temporary errors (timeout, HTTP 429/5xx); the wait doubles each time.

contentFormat.label: Chapter content format
contentFormat.description: Only applies to chapters downloaded from now on.

readOnly.note: To change these two, edit the .env file and restart the server.
readOnly.passwordHidden: The password, if any, is masked.

novels.title: Novels
novels.description: Search by title or author, accents are optional.

noMatch.title: No novels match the filters
noMatch.description: Try another keyword or remove some filters.

empty.title: No novels yet
empty.description: Novels appear here after the first crawl.

validation.url: Enter the full URL of the novel, e.g. https://truyenfull.live/ten-truyen/
validation.range: The last chapter must be greater than or equal to the first chapter

crawl.description: Paste the URL of the novel (a chapter URL works too). However often you rerun it, only the missing parts are downloaded.
crawl.fromHint: By position in the table of contents
crawl.toHint: Leave empty = to the end of the novel

skipExisting.label: Skip chapters already downloaded
skipExisting.description: Untick to download everything again; only chapters whose content changed are overwritten.

crawl.compliance: The crawler obeys robots.txt, spaces out its requests and stops when the website refuses. Only crawl content you are allowed to use.

api.timeout: The server took too long to respond. Check the backend and try again.
api.network: Could not connect to the server. Check that the backend (crawl-data-app serve) is running.
api.unreachable: Could not reach the backend (HTTP {{status}}). Check that crawl-data-app serve is running.
api.serverError: The server ran into an error (HTTP {{status}}). Check the backend logs and try again.
api.failed: The request could not be completed (HTTP {{status}}).

codes.not_found: The requested data was not found.
codes.unsupported_source: The source of this URL is not supported yet.
codes.duplicate_job: A job is already running for this.
codes.job_not_running: The job is no longer running, so this action is not available.
codes.cross_origin: The request came from another website and was rejected.
codes.owner_only: Only the server owner can change the configuration.
codes.admin_only: Only administrators can view and manage feedback.
codes.admin_disabled: Administration is off: set ADMIN_TOKEN in the server's .env file.

sources.title: Novel sources
sources.description: The websites the crawler can read. Add a new source by writing a crawler in the backend.
sources.noDescription: This crawler has no description yet.
sources.robotsNote: The crawler always reads robots.txt first and stops when the website refuses. Change the values above on the <settings>Settings</settings> page.

disableConfirm.title: Disable source {{name}}?
disableConfirm.body: No new jobs can be created for this source until it is enabled again. Running jobs and crawled data are not affected.

sources.empty: The backend has no crawlers registered

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel job #{{id}}?
cancelConfirm.novel: The job will stop for good and will not restart on its own. Chapters already downloaded are kept; create a new job to continue.
cancelConfirm.sync: The job will stop for good and will not restart on its own. Data from earlier syncs is not affected.

job.rerunCreated: Created a new job that reruns the same scope

empty.title: No log entries for this job yet
empty.description: Entries of old jobs may be in a log file that has been rotated.

job.otherProcess: This job is running in another process (for example the crawl-data-app crawl command), so it cannot be paused or cancelled from here.

sync.createFailed: Could not create the sync job
sync.lastFailed: The last sync (<job>job #{{id}}</job>) did not complete
sync.firstDescription: The data will appear here when the job finishes.
sync.historyEmptyDescription: The history appears after the first sync.

sourceNote.world: Open data: airports and countries from OurAirports (public domain), airlines from OpenFlights (ODbL licence, attribution required when reused).
sourceNote.vna: Taken from vietnamairlines.com, for personal, non-commercial use only.

world.airport: Only airports still in operation that have an IATA code.
world.city: Cities are derived from airports; their codes are made up by this app because the open data has no city codes.
world.airline: Only active airlines that have an IATA code; OpenFlights is rarely updated, so newer airlines may be missing.

vna.airport: Only airports in the network of Vietnam Airlines and its partners.
vna.airline: Only airlines whose frequent flyer programme is linked with Vietnam Airlines.

aviation.emptyDescription: Press Sync to download the catalogue of this source (three requests, updating all four kinds of data).
aviation.historyDescription: Each sync is a job that downloads all four kinds of data of this source again. A failed or stopped job does not lose the existing data.

provinces.sourceNote: Taken from the open dataset vietnamese-provinces-database (MIT licence), using the boundaries after the 2025 merger.
provinces.emptyDescription: Press Sync to download the provinces together with their wards (one request).
provinces.historyDescription: Each sync is a job that downloads the whole catalogue (provinces and wards) again. A failed or stopped job does not lose the existing data.

wards.description: Wards, communes and special zones — the level right below provinces.

noMatch.title: No matching wards
noMatch.description: Try another code, name or province.

range.title: Download a chapter range
range.force: Download existing chapters again (only chapters whose content changed are overwritten)

export.note: The file contains the novel details and the text of the chapters already downloaded ({{done}} so far)
export.rangeNote: ; a range with no downloaded chapters produces no file

reload.title: Download chapter {{number}} again?
reload.body: The stored content of this chapter will be overwritten if the version on the source website has changed.

noToc.title: No table of contents yet
noToc.description: Only the details of this novel have been fetched. Press “Download missing chapters” to get the table of contents and the text.

novel.author: Author
novel.meta: Last crawled: {{crawled}} · Published on the source: {{published}} · Pending chapters: {{pending}}
novel.noJobs: No jobs for this novel yet

crawler.description: Which website or dataset you would like the system to collect, and what for.

validation.title: Title must be 3 to 200 characters

feedback.attachmentNote: Attachments are not supported yet: paste a link to a screenshot in the description if needed.
